findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 5317
findings.details: [SCAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED] 字源 PDF p. 739 / printed p. 726 shows a sequence of historical glyph specimens labeled 商, 西周, 春秋, 战国, 小篆, 汉, and 楷书. The surrounding entry text and headings were read, but individual specimen identities were not separately checked against the cited source works. Do not use a specific specimen as independent evidence without targeted verification.
findings.verification: Check the identified printed page and exact scan span; correct source-bound OCR or record an unresolved glyph identity.
